verses.ar: صَلَاةٌ لِمِسْكِينٍ إِذَا أَعْيَا وَسَكَبَ شَكْوَاهُ قُدَّامَ ٱللهِ يَارَبُّ، ٱسْتَمِعْ صَلَاتِي، وَلْيَدْخُلْ إِلَيْكَ صُرَاخِي.
verses.kjv: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.web: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh. Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
verses.he: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֹֽו׃ יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֹֽוא׃

verses.ar: لَا تَحْجُبْ وَجْهَكَ عَنِّي فِي يَوْمِ ضِيقِي. أَمِلْ إِلَيَّ أُذُنَكَ فِي يَوْمِ أَدْعُوكَ. ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي سَرِيعًا.
verses.kjv: Hide not thy face from me in the day [when] I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day [when] I call answer me speedily.
verses.web: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
verses.he: אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּיֹ֪ום צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּיֹ֥ום אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ أَيَّامِي قَدْ فَنِيَتْ فِي دُخَانٍ، وَعِظَامِي مِثْلُ وَقِيدٍ قَدْ يَبِسَتْ.
verses.kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.web: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
verses.he: כִּֽי־כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמֹותַ֗י כְּמֹו־קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: مَلْفُوحٌ كَٱلْعُشْبِ وَيَابِسٌ قَلْبِي، حَتَّى سَهَوْتُ عَنْ أَكْلِ خُبْزِي.
verses.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.web: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
verses.he: הוּכָּֽה־כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃

verses.ar: مِنْ صَوْتِ تَنَهُّدِي لَصِقَ عَظْمِي بِلَحْمِي.
verses.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.web: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
verses.he: מִקֹּ֥ול אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃

verses.ar: أَشْبَهْتُ قُوقَ ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ. صِرْتُ مِثْلَ بُومَةِ ٱلْخِرَبِ.
verses.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.web: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.he: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכֹ֣וס חֳרָבֹֽות׃

verses.ar: سَهِدْتُ وَصِرْتُ كَعُصْفُورٍ مُنْفَرِدٍ عَلَى ٱلسَّطْحِ.
verses.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.web: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
verses.he: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפֹּ֗ור בֹּודֵ֥ד עַל־גָּֽג׃

verses.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ عَيَّرَنِي أَعْدَائِيَ. ٱلْحَنِقُونَ عَلَيَّ حَلَفُوا عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; [and] they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.web: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
verses.he: כָּל־הַ֭יֹּום חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אֹויְבָ֑י מְ֝הֹולָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃

verses.ar: إِنِّي قَدْ أَكَلْتُ ٱلرَّمَادَ مِثْلَ ٱلْخُبْزِ، وَمَزَجْتُ شَرَابِي بِدُمُوعٍ،
verses.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.web: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
verses.he: כִּי־אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃

verses.ar: بِسَبَبِ غَضَبِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ، لِأَنَّكَ حَمَلْتَنِي وَطَرَحْتَنِي.
verses.kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.web: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
verses.he: מִפְּנֵֽי־זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: أَيَّامِي كَظِلٍّ مَائِلٍ، وَأَنَا مِثْلُ ٱلْعُشْبِ يَبِسْتُ.
verses.kjv: My days [are] like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.web: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
verses.he: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ فَإِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ جَالِسٌ، وَذِكْرُكَ إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ.
verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.web: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעֹולָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

verses.ar: أَنْتَ تَقُومُ وَتَرْحَمُ صِهْيَوْنَ، لِأَنَّهُ وَقْتُ ٱلرَّأْفَةِ، لِأَنَّهُ جَاءَ ٱلْمِيعَادُ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt arise, [and] have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.web: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
verses.he: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיֹּ֑ון כִּי־עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־בָ֥א מֹועֵֽד׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ عَبِيدَكَ قَدْ سُرُّوا بِحِجَارَتِهَا، وَحَنُّوا إِلَى تُرَابِهَا.
verses.kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.web: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
verses.he: כִּֽי־רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃

verses.ar: فَتَخْشَى ٱلْأُمَمُ ٱسْمَ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَكُلُّ مُلُوكِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَجْدَكَ.
verses.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.web: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.he: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ גֹ֭ויִם אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־כְּבֹודֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: إِذَا بَنَى ٱلرَّبُّ صِهْيَوْنَ يُرَى بِمَجْدِهِ.
verses.kjv: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.web: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
verses.he: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיֹּ֑ון נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבֹודֹֽו׃

verses.ar: ٱلْتَفَتَ إِلَى صَلَاةِ ٱلْمُضْطَرِّ، وَلَمْ يَرْذُلْ دُعَاءَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.web: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
verses.he: פָּ֭נָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא־בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃

verses.ar: يُكْتَبُ هَذَا لِلدَّوْرِ ٱلْآخِرِ، وشَعْبٌ سَوْفَ يُخْلَقُ يُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّبَّ:
verses.kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
verses.web: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah,
verses.he: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְדֹ֣ור אַחֲרֹ֑ון וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־יָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: «لِأَنَّهُ أَشْرَفَ مِنْ عُلْوِ قُدْسِهِ. ٱلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ نَظَرَ،
verses.kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
verses.web: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth,
verses.he: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּרֹ֣ום קָדְשֹׁ֑ו יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם ׀ אֶל־אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃

verses.ar: لِيَسْمَعَ أَنِينَ ٱلْأَسِيرِ، لِيُطْلِقَ بَنِي ٱلْمَوْتِ».
verses.kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.web: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
verses.he: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃

verses.ar: لِكَيْ يُحَدَّثَ فِي صِهْيَوْنَ بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَبِتَسْبِيحِهِ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ،
verses.kjv: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.web: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
verses.he: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיֹּון שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּתֹ֗ו בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃

verses.ar: عِنْدَ ٱجْتِمَاعِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ مَعًا وَٱلْمَمَالِكِ لِعِبَادَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.web: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
verses.he: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכֹ֗ות לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: ضَعَّفَ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ قُوَّتِي، قَصَّرَ أَيَّامِي.
verses.kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.web: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
verses.he: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ *כֹּחֹו (כֹּחִ֗י) קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃

verses.ar: أَقُولُ: «يَا إِلَهِي، لَا تَقْبِضْنِي فِي نِصْفِ أَيَّامِي. إِلَى دَهْرِ ٱلدُّهُورِ سِنُوكَ.
verses.kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years [are] throughout all generations.
verses.web: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.he: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּדֹ֖ור דֹּורִ֣ים שְׁנֹותֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: مِنْ قِدَمٍ أَسَّسْتَ ٱلْأَرْضَ، وَٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ هِيَ عَمَلُ يَدَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens [are] the work of thy hands.
verses.web: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.he: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: هِيَ تَبِيدُ وَأَنْتَ تَبْقَى، وَكُلُّهَا كَثَوْبٍ تَبْلَى، كَرِدَاءٍ تُغَيِّرُهُنَّ فَتَتَغَيَّرُ.
verses.kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.web: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
verses.he: הֵ֤מָּה ׀ יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וֽ͏ְיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃

verses.ar: وَأَنْتَ هُوَ وَسِنُوكَ لَنْ تَنْتَهِيَ.
verses.kjv: But thou [art] the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.web: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
verses.he: וְאַתָּה־ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנֹותֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃

verses.ar: أَبْنَاءُ عَبِيدِكَ يَسْكُنُونَ، وَذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ تُثَبَّتُ أَمَامَكَ».
verses.kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.web: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
verses.he: בְּנֵֽי־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכֹּ֑ונוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽון׃
